source: EN texts are copied verbatim from the 'Learning Objectives for Chapter N' lists of the ISTQB® Certified Tester AI Testing (CT-AI) Syllabus v2.0 (GA 2026-04-17), with wrapped lines joined. TR texts are editorial translations, because no Turkish v2.0 syllabus exists; their terminology is taken from data/ct-ai-v2.0/terms.json, which uses the TTB CT-AI v1.0 Turkish syllabus wherever the term exists there, and they reuse the wording of a v1.0 Turkish learning objective where it says the same thing. Only the 43 examinable K2/K3 objectives are listed; the hands-on objectives (HO-, H1/H2) are not examined and are excluded.

text.en: Differentiate between AI-based systems and conventional systems
text.tr: Yapay zekâ tabanlı sistemler ile geleneksel sistemler arasındaki farkları belirtmek

text.en: Distinguish between narrow AI, general AI, and super AI
text.tr: Dar yapay zekâ, genel yapay zekâ ve süper yapay zekâ arasındaki farkları belirtmek

text.en: Explain the different types of AI technologies
text.tr: Farklı yapay zekâ teknolojisi türlerini açıklamak

text.en: Explain generative AI
text.tr: Üretken yapay zekâyı açıklamak

text.en: Compare the choices available for hardware to implement machine learning systems
text.tr: Makine öğrenimi sistemlerini uygulamak için mevcut donanım seçeneklerini karşılaştırmak

text.en: Compare the options for the development and hosting of AI models
